QuestInfo.name: Mixed Mutation
QuestInfo.1: Bruce thinks the vitality of the Primroses is what gives the Golems life. Since it is a random effect, it also creates mutants like the Mixed Golems. It all sounds impossible, but bring 10 Mixed Golem Rubbles to Bruce so he can continue his research and perhaps convince you.
QuestInfo.2: You brought Bruce the Mixed Golem Rubbles so he could continue with his research. Could the Primroses really have such power?

0.0: Wait, no, they're flowers. My head is finally clearing up. I really have to stop eating those spores, but the burning starts to taste GREAT after a few tablespoons. I'm thinking more about these Snooty- sorry, PRIMroses. What if their power is what brings the Mixed Golems to life? Sort of a mixing of flower power and stone! I must research this! Go get me some!

yes.0: Bring me 10 Mixed Golem Rubbles immediately! This could be it!\r\n

no.0: But, there is science to be done! I knew I should have given this job to that evil robot lady.

1.0: I'm glad you're back. I was running out of test materials.\r\n

yes.0: Wow, that is a lot more rubble than I thought. I guess I went overboard a little bit. Good news for you, I suppose. Go take a coffee break and get back here when you can.\r\n

item.0: Bring me 10 Mixed Golem Rubbles immediately! This could be it!\r\n
